status: frozen before task generation; human n=0
truth: Actual edited frozen neural forward minus baseline, selected normalized output; not economic teacher policy
sampling: Fresh capital uniform [0.5,1.8]*kss; shock state stationary over all 21 states. Reject only previously used raw input pairs, never edited outcomes. Uniform baseline-active target units; W2 upstream uniform baseline-active H1.
forms: A/B matched only on family and selected output, three outputs per family; no effect matching
disclosure: Every case exposes physical and normalized inputs/outputs and baseline p1,h1,p2,h2; both arms have complete weights, TRAIN normalization, DISCOVERY labels and generic simulation code
guide: Adds compact gate-update/readout explanation and only two practice worked examples. No test answers or dedicated answer button. Full independent simulation allowed in both arms.
practice: One H1 removal and one H2 removal; answers and edited traces disclosed only here

metrics.primary: participant mean absolute error in TRAIN output SD units
metrics.stratify: all four families, including every null and sham

human_pilot.allocation: six seeded random blocks containing all condition/form cells; slots 0..23; replacement uses the same unfilled slot
human_pilot.analysis: human participant is unit; report cell means and family strata; descriptive pilot, no confirmatory significance claim; agent_smoke and demo separate

response_schema.task_order: permutation of all assigned form task IDs

responses.prediction_sd: finite number, TRAIN output SD delta

response_schema.total_ms: finite nonnegative number, at least sum response_ms + materials_ms

exclusions: Reject invalid hashes, incomplete/duplicate task IDs, invalid numbers, assignment mismatch, invalid participant kind, duplicate participant IDs in pooled input. No outcome-based exclusions.
scope: No training, recruitment, publication, or human hardness inference. Automated baseline evaluations are not a human study. The complete model is mathematically sufficient for every answer.
